result.rationale: The rescue team repeatedly fails to make progress on the primary objective (rescue-two-civilians stays at 0/2 across all 6 turns) because hostile and environmental pressure blocks the actors before the useful affordance becomes actionable. Engineer Imani is repeatedly attacked by Raider Holt (turns 2, 3, 4) dropping from 100 to 17 health while shuttling between storage-floor and junction-console, never reaching civilian-kade at life-console. Medic Reyes escorts civilian-sato but is contested at junction-cover (turn 4, target_zone_capacity_lost) and cannot route to rescue-airlock because pirates hold the junction. Security Chen takes repeated reactor-environment damage (10/turn) while guarding/moving through reactor-entry. Reactor heat climbs 62→100 and oxygen drains 68→42, adding survival pressure that outpaces any rescue progress. The core blocker is spatial/hostile pressure (Raider Holt's scatter-blast on the power-junction corridor, zone capacity contestation, reactor hazard) preventing the team from converting known civilian locations into extraction.
